entities.name: Gala Dalí
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gala Dalí, usually known simply as Gala, was the wife of poet Paul Éluard (1895–1952) and later of artist Salvador Dalí (1904–1989), who were both prominent in surrealism. She also inspired many other writers and artists.
